name: Govee
description: Govee Wi-Fi lights over Govee's public LAN API (turn on "LAN Control" in the Govee Home app): multicast scan on UDP 4001, replies on 4002, JSON commands to the light on 4003. One colour per light; optional per-segment streaming adapted from OpenRGB's GoveeController (GPL-2.0-or-later). Untested: nobody working on HueDeck owns a Govee light. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/govee.md.
